# Karol Digital

> Web design for pole and aerial studios — custom studio booking systems UK, dance timetables, and checkout under your domain. Replace Bookwhen or TeamUp. Also: finance, immigration, trades, and catering.

## About

Karol Digital is a London SW20 studio. Primary focus: pole dancing, aerial hoop, and aerial silk class businesses (Fitness & Wellness). Proof of concept: https://wildheartscollective.org. Secondary industries: financial services, immigration lawyers, construction & trades, catering & hospitality.

- Phone: 07565 472445
- Location: London SW20, United Kingdom
